## Sprint-specific acceptance criteria

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Every linked sub-issue meets its acceptance criteria, or remaining work is explicitly carried over.
- [ ] Relevant tests and checks pass; anything not run or still failing is documented.
- [ ] Required documentation and delivery evidence are updated.
- [ ] Delivery PRs are reviewed and merged into the agreed target branch.
- [ ] Known risks and follow-up work are recorded; no blocker is silently treated as accepted.
